systems.system: National Advisory Committee for Community Networks in Nigeria (NACN)
systems.country_label: advisory committee of regulators, civil society and communities that backed a civil-society-led strategy; no setup by law, decree, minister or regulator and no opinion on a named government policy stated

systems.system: National Strategy for Community-Centred Connectivity Initiatives in Nigeria
systems.country_label: strategy built by a multistakeholder group from 2024; not stated as asked for by government
